mentions.name: LocalGeoguessr
mentions.description: A geography game that tests how well players know their local area by guessing the locations of nearby places. Still early-stage but playable, with plans to add themed categories such as restaurants, theaters, and roads so users can play based on local themes.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m building a small side project called https://www.localgeoguessr.com/
 — a fun geography game that tests how well you know your local area. It’s still in a very early stage, not polished yet, but it’s somewhat playable.
